svg.title: NKp44: one Ig-like ectodomain and DAP12
svg.desc: NCR domain counts differ. Adapter labels denote schematic CD3ζ / FcRγ or DAP12 association, not the same adapter for all NCRs. NKp44 splice/ITIM biology is not reduced to a universal activation rule. Native editable vector; domain cartoons are not atomic models.
